name: Olías del Rey (Spain)
description: Purple field with a yellow triangle rising from the lower edge, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Olías del Rey (the letters FY and a crescent on blue and white).
history: Municipal flag of Olías del Rey; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the lower edge and its apex at the centre
Olías del Rey arms — crowned letters FY on blue and a crescent on white
